club_key: canonical club name in audited NAME_MAP values across seasons; season-team IDs only target joins; no new alias unless recorded
cutoff: FPL GW deadline minus3h; strictly prior sources only; reject target-match odds
target_outcome_safety: No target-match or not-yet-prior outcome enters features. Per brief3/9 past completed matches from the current test season may enter chronological histories, never GLM/scaler training. All feature-source maxima must be strictly before that row origin.
targets: official FPL team_h_score/team_a_score, deduplicated fixture/team, both sides, identical keys/labels/origins in all arms
cohort: All760 team-matches in each held-out test season; all760 per train season; any nonfinite C/U/M feature or target aborts entire Stage B, no imputation/drop

operators.C: fpl_model.ew; goals GF/GA, half-lives4/12, prior1.35,mass4, per-club season reset
operators.U: C plus exact same ew operator on frozen I4 Understat team/opp xG/xGA, half-lives4/12, prior1.35,mass4, season reset; no arithmetic I4 windows
operators.M: C plus natural logs of fixed market lambda projections; independent of target odds

market_rating.source: the already-frozen1900 admitted probability inversions, no repeat inversion
market_rating.fixed_origin_rating_fits: one deterministic feature-transform ridge per unique origin, shared across arms/folds; not additional GLM arms

learner.standardisation: StandardScaler fitted only on that fold train seasons, including home; test rows never fit transforms
learner.convergence: ConvergenceWarning or nonfinite/nonpositive prediction aborts; no changed optimiser/refit

metrics.primary: sklearn mean_poisson_deviance on all held-out team-match rows
metrics.calibration_slope: Algebraic OLS rate calibration y~intercept+predicted_lambda: cov(pred,y)/var(pred), intercept=mean(y)-slope*mean(pred); no extra GLM fits. Undefined zero variance -> null, no fabricated value. This is rate-scale slope, not log-link recalibration.
metrics.intervals: Paired M-minus-C and M-minus-U per-row Poisson deviance; fixed GW blocks1-4,5-8,...,37-38; delete-one-block jackknife SE sqrt((B-1)/B * sum((theta_leave - mean(theta_leave))**2)); interval full-row mean delta +/-1.96*SE. Descriptive only, dependent reused seasons, unequal block lengths; not a significance gate. No bootstrap seed or resampling search.

Gate_B: M mean test Poisson deviance strictly less than C AND U separately in EACH fold; no rounding before gate

stops.pass: Mandatory architect handover09 before any Stage C
stops.fail: Stop modelling, Stage E negative publication/review/CI/release then handover09
stops.failure: Preserve failed attempt/log/resources; do not spend more than6attempts, silently refit, impute or change scope

resources.storage_scope: All new worker outputs under private package work root; account prior package data/tests/log growth conservatively against total growth before each job; external writes prohibited by worker design, guard is not a security sandbox

seeds: No randomised Stage-B procedure or seed; unchanged seed20260921 reserved for separately reviewed Stage C
